decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Flood Risk Assessment, Location Plan, 010 Rev A, 011 Rev A, 020, 021 Rev A, 110 Rev E, 111 Rev E, 120 Rev E, and 121 Rev E received: 02/07/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a rear roof extension and outrigger incorporating two front roof windows and the erection of a single storey rear extension following the demolition of the existing conservatory.
